instruction: You are given a template `/home/user/Desktop/curve_base.py`. Complete the following from the command line: 1. Write a complete script `/home/user/Desktop/curve.py`: - Build a single-turbine wind farm (NREL 5MW) - Sweep wind speeds: `4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20 m/s` - For each wind speed, execute `run_no_wake()` (to avoid wake interference) - Extract power (kW) and thrust coefficient `Ct` 2.
